description: This file defines a Kotlin class SecurePrefs that manages secure and regular shared preferences for an Android app. It handles encrypted storage, preference migration, and exposes a variety of app-specific settings via Kotlin StateFlows, including device info, notification settings, and gateway tokens.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: A class for managing secure and plain shared preferences, providing app-specific configuration options, including device info, notification settings, and gateway credentials. It supports encryption, migrating preferences, and reactive state flows for real-time updates.

methods.name: setLastDiscoveredStableId
methods.description: Stores a trimmed version of the provided stable ID in preferences and updates the respective state flow.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets and saves a trimmed display name in preferences and updates its state flow.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables camera usage and updates its state flow.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the location mode (e.g., off, always) and updates the state flow.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location and updates the state flow.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Configures whether to prevent display sleep and updates the state flow.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual gateway configuration.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets the manual gateway host address.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets the manual gateway port number.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual gateway connection.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores a gateway token securely and updates its state flow.

methods.name: setGatewayPassword
methods.description: Saves the gateway password securely.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores a bootstrap token securely.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed in preferences.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status and updates state.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy
methods.description: Returns a policy object defining notification forwarding rules based on preferences for a specific app package.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets the notification filtering mode (allowlist or blocklist).

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackages
methods.description: Updates the list of packages to which notifications are forwarded.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding, including start/end times and enabled state.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Configures the maximum number of notification forwarding events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Stores a session key used in notification forwarding policy.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored gateway token, checking both in memory, secured prefs, or fallback logic.

methods.name: saveGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway token securely, indexed by instance ID.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token from secure storage.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the bootstrap token securely.

methods.name: loadGatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the stored gateway password.

methods.name: saveGatewayPassword
methods.description: Stores the gateway password securely.

methods.name: loadGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Loads the TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Saves the TLS fingerprint for a specified stable ID.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from encrypted preferences.

methods.name: putString
methods.description: Stores a string value into encrypted preferences.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key/value pair from encrypted preferences.

methods.name: loadWakeWords
methods.description: Loads and sanitizes wake words from preferences.

methods.name: loadVoiceWakeMode
methods.description: Retrieves the voice wake mode setting, defaults to ON.

methods.name: loadLocationMode
methods.description: Retrieves and possibly normalizes the location mode setting.
